resale_co.name: No resale Certificate of Occupancy; Letter of No Interest required instead
resale_co.issued_by: Construction Office, Department of Community Development
resale_co.lead_time: Allow 14 business days for the Letter of No Interest
requirements: No open construction permits (the Letter of No Interest confirms this for the buyer)

fees.label: Letter of No Interest (required instead of a resale certificate of occupancy)
fees.quote: Lacey Township does require a Letter of No Interest . The cost of the letter is $50 cash or check payable to Township of Lacey .

resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the Request for Letter of No Interest, fill in the block, lot, address, requester and closing date, and submit it with the $50 fee (cash, or check payable to the Township of Lacey) to the Construction Office, 124 South Main Street, Forked River (mail to 818 Lacey Road). Faxed requests are not accepted. The letter can be mailed, picked up or emailed. Allow 14 business days.
resale_co.contact_title: Director, Community Development (department that runs the Construction Office)

evidence.quote: Lacey Township does not require a Certificate of Occupancy for resale. Lacey Township does require a Letter of No Interest .

Download a Request for a Letter of No Interest (PDF) in lieu of a certificate of occupancy. This letter will assure the buyer that there are no open permits on the residence. Please allow 14 days for processing.
Please allow 14 business days to process your request.
Christopher Reid Director Community Development Director Community Development
There is a $50.00 processing fee for all Letters of No Interest. The fee must be paid at the time the request is made.

resale_co.notes: Lacey states plainly that it does not require a Certificate of Occupancy for a resale; instead it requires a $50 Letter of No Interest from the Construction Office confirming there are no open permits. The request form (dated 10-7-2016) lists the Construction Office at (609) 693-1100 ext. 2252/2253 and lacey.building@laceytownship.org. The Building Department page names two different Construction Officials (Doug Donohue in the text and Jim Peters in the inspector list), so neither is used as the contact; the directory's Director of Community Development is given instead. Code Enforcement (609-693-1100 ext. 2249, codeenforcement@laceytownship.org) handles rental/leased property maintenance, not sales. Re-checked 2026-10-06: the directory page is now titled 'Building, Land Use & Development' and hides email addresses behind Cloudflare email protection; Christopher Reid's link still decodes to lacey.commdev@laceytownship.org, and the Community Development line is still 609-693-1100 Ext: 2253.

requirements: CO alarms within about 10 feet of sleeping areas when the home has a fuel-burning appliance or attached garage (battery, hardwired or plug-in allowed)
State online form (CSACMASPSIL) covers smoke alarms, CO alarms and the secondary power source label; no fire extinguisher

authorities.name: NJ DCA Division of Fire Safety, Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement
authorities.lead_time: More than 10 business days before closing for the lowest fee; a new application is needed if the change of occupant does not happen within 6 months

fees.label: State fee: Request received more than 10 business days before the change of occupant (N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9(d))
fees.quote: Requests for a CSACMAPFEC received more than 10 business days prior to the change of occupant: $45.00

fees.label: State fee: Request received 4 to 10 business days before the change of occupant
fees.quote: Requests for a CSACMAPFEC received four to 10 business days prior to the change of occupant: $90.00

fees.label: State fee: Request received fewer than 4 business days before the change of occupant
fees.quote: Requests for a CSACMAPFEC received fewer than four business days prior to the change of occupant: $161.00

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply online on the NJ DCA Fire Safety portal (the Township's Building Department page links to it). The applicant checks off each smoke alarm, CO alarm and power source label requirement and pays by e-check or credit card before submitting. The certificate is emailed once the fee is paid and any required inspection is done. Homes heated by electricity with no CO requirement should email BFCE_CSDCMAC@dca.nj.gov.
authorities.contact_title: Fire Official (NJ Division of Fire Safety, Deputy Division Director)

fire_cert.notes: Lacey has no local fire code enforcing agency; the NJ DCA enforces the code (registry code S) and issues smoke certificates there ('SC' on the DCA state-towns list revised 7/17/2026, where Lacey is listed under directory code 1512; Watchdog code 1513). The Township's Building Department page links sellers to the DCA online application. The DCA fee sentence sits in the portal page's script rather than the visible text. The Forked River and Lanoka Harbor fire companies are volunteer fire companies, not the enforcing agency. Re-checked 2026-10-06: state fees are now cited from the NJ Register adoption notice (N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9(d)) instead of the DCA portal script text; the amounts ($45 / $90 / $161) are unchanged and the portal page source still shows them.
